mapper.select: SELECT sc.student_id, u.username, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.real_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname), ''), u.username) AS display_name, COALESCE(reading.reading_sessions, 0) AS reading_sessions, COALESCE(reading.texts_read, 0) AS texts_read, reading.last_reading_at, COALESCE(quiz.practice_attempts, 0) AS practice_attempts, COALESCE(quiz.correct_answers, 0) AS correct_answers, COALESCE(quiz.answered_questions, 0) AS answered_questions, quiz.last_practice_at FROM student_classes sc JOIN users u ON u.id = sc.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.student_id, COUNT(*) AS reading_sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT r.text_id) AS texts_read, MAX(r.start_time) AS last_reading_at FROM text_learning_records r JOIN student_classes member ON member.student_id = r.student_id AND member.class_id = #{classId} AND (member.status = 'ACTIVE' OR member.status IS NULL) WHERE r.start_time >= #{fromTime} AND r.start_time < #{untilTime} GROUP BY r.student_id ) reading ON reading.student_id = sc.student_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.student_id, COUNT(*) AS practice_attempts, SUM(a.correct_count) AS correct_answers, SUM(a.total_questions) AS answered_questions, MAX(a.submitted_time) AS last_practice_at FROM student_ai_quiz_attempts a JOIN student_classes member ON member.student_id = a.student_id AND member.class_id = #{classId} AND (member.status = 'ACTIVE' OR member.status IS NULL) WHERE a.submitted_time >= #{fromTime} AND a.submitted_time < #{untilTime} GROUP BY a.student_id ) quiz ON quiz.student_id = sc.student_id WHERE sc.class_id = #{classId} AND (sc.status = 'ACTIVE' OR sc.status IS NULL) ORDER BY display_name, sc.student_id

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(r.start_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(r.start_time) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT r.student_id) AS reading_students, COUNT(*) AS reading_sessions FROM text_learning_records r JOIN student_classes sc ON sc.student_id = r.student_id AND sc.class_id = #{classId} AND (sc.status = 'ACTIVE' OR sc.status IS NULL) JOIN users u ON u.id = r.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE r.start_time >= #{fromTime} AND r.start_time < #{untilTime} GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start

SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(a.submitted_time), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(a.submitted_time) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) AS quiz_students, COUNT(*) AS practice_attempts, SUM(a.correct_count) AS correct_answers, SUM(a.total_questions) AS answered_questions FROM student_ai_quiz_attempts a JOIN student_classes sc ON sc.student_id = a.student_id AND sc.class_id = #{classId} AND (sc.status = 'ACTIVE' OR sc.status IS NULL) JOIN users u ON u.id = a.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE a.submitted_time >= #{fromTime} AND a.submitted_time < #{untilTime} GROUP BY week_start ORDER BY week_start
